_comment: Key and attunement items of the dungeons and raids of tools/forever_dungeons.json, kept by hand; tools/build_dungeons.py writes them as keys = { ... } into Amisia/Data/DungeonData.lua. Per dungeon key a list of items: item (item id), name (English, as ItemSparse names it; checked by the tests, not written), need (required: no entry or no boss without it; optional: a shortcut, a wing, an extra boss), why (door: opens the dungeon or its door; part: opens a part or wing; summon: summons a boss; attune: attunement to enter; boss: needed for a boss), quests (the quest ids that lead to the item, in order, only where the repo's quest data has them with that title; questsA/questsH where the factions differ), src (see sources), note (what it does). Dungeons without a key are left out; the Forever-only dungeons get a key only where the client or quest data shows one clearly.

sources.classic: The key's role as the Classic game has it (which door, wing or boss), checked by hand; the item id and its English name are the client's own (ItemSparse 1.60.1.70862). Whether Forever changed the role is not verified in game.
sources.classic+quests: As classic; the quests are the chain of Amisia/Data/DungeonQuestData.lua (ids, titles and pre-quests as that file has them), whose last quest rewards the item there.

gnomer.name: Workshop Key
gnomer.note: opens the back door (the workshop entrance)

sm.name: The Scarlet Key
sm.note: opens the doors of the Armory and the Cathedral

mara.name: Scepter of Celebras
mara.note: opens the portal to the inner part

dire.name: Crescent Key
dire.note: opens the doors of the west and north wings

dire.name: Gordok Courtyard Key
dire.note: opens the courtyard door in the north wing

dire.name: Gordok Inner Door Key
dire.note: opens the inner door in the north wing

onyxia.name: Drakefire Amulet
onyxia.note: lets its bearer enter Onyxia's Lair
